title: kate-fileio: open a load without blocking
summary: load opens the path with the non-blocking flag, then rejects a handle that is not a file. A FIFO returns an Io error within two seconds. The test goes in the existing load tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: load.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Add two functions named open_load_file. The unix function has #[cfg(unix)]. It uses OpenOptions read true and custom_flags. On linux the flag is 0x800. On every other unix target the flag is 0x4. Use the same cfg(target_os = "linux") split as open_config_handle in modeline.rs. The other function has #[cfg(not(unix))] and calls File::open. In load, delete the path metadata check. Write this exact line: let file = open_load_file(path).map_err(LoadError::Io)?; Then let meta = file.metadata().map_err(LoadError::Io)?; When meta.is_file() is false, return Err(LoadError::Io) with ErrorKind::InvalidInput and the message not a regular file. Do not match the Result by hand. Use map_err and the ? operator. Do not touch sha256, the max_bytes check, decode, or Loaded. The existing test a_fifo_returns_promptly stays green. open_load_file_returns_a_small_file writes hello and a newline, opens that path, and asserts the handle metadata is a file. A directory path makes load return LoadError::Io. a_fifo_load_open_returns_within_two_seconds creates a fifo with mkfifo, calls open_load_file on a worker thread, and waits at most two seconds. The call returns. load of that fifo still returns LoadError::Io. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: load::tests::open_load_file_returns_a_small_file
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because open_load_file does not exist. A small file returns a handle whose metadata is a file. load of a directory returns LoadError::Io. A fifo open returns within two seconds, and load of that fifo returns LoadError::Io.
